top_signals.title: Ebola Disrupts Congo’s Childhood Vaccinations, Maternity and Health Services
top_signals.summary: Routine healthcare has been severely disrupted in communities hit hardest by Ebola in Democratic Republic of Congo, where fear of infection and pressure on hospitals are stymieing pediatric immunizations and discouraging patients from seeking maternity and other basic care.
